entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Joker...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: As I expected, you appear to be safe...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: However, where exactly are we?
Outside the Velvet Room.
You seem to be okay.
Come with me.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Velvet... Room? I'm not sure[n]I understand...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes... Sorry to have worried you...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: At first, I was surprised to see the masses[n]chained in a prison, yet here I am as well...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Considering the state of the real world...[n]it is hard to say that we were even[n]remotely helpful...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This situation... Can we truly handle such[n]horrid circumstances?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: All the Phantom Thieves can do is change[n]the hearts of others.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: However, the world outside has become[n]a veritable hell. Nothing within our power[n]can fix that...
Are you giving up?
Are you scared?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...I'm merely acknowledging how[n]powerless I am.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I believe I feel more powerless than[n]anything...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The people of this world desired their[n]enslavement.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That isn't all... They screamed at us for[n]attacking the Holy Grail, defended it...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Even the criminals whose hearts we[n]changed became meek followers of[n]the Holy Grail because of us.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Were we truly that foolish, risking our[n]lives for a result nobody desired?
Why were you fighting?
What about your justice?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...That's right.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It wasn't just for recognition from those[n]we were helping. My purpose lies[n]elsewhere...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: My justice...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...I see.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Not that for someone else, but one[n]strictly for myself...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: When we first met... you continued to[n]impose yourselves on me no matter[n]how much I pushed you away.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I will forever treasure what you did[n]for me.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...Very well!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Just as art is meant to break boundaries,[n]people should be saved even if they[n]frown upon it.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I won't allow the justice I believe in[n]to be shaken any further!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Allow me to thank you, Joker.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Being by your side truly gives rise to[n]the greatest ideas!
We should get moving.
Break time's over.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ah, yes! We cannot afford to leave reality[n]in the hellish state it's currently in.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I will make use of my role as an artist and[n]paint over the distortions of society!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Well then, time to go and see this through.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'll witness with my own two eyes that[n]this world isn't bound by some Holy[n]Grail.
